headline: Rockstar releases new GTA VI trailer
summary: Rockstar Games released a new launch trailer for Grand Theft Auto VI ahead of its release, though outlets disagree on whether it reveals much new information.

claims.statement: Rockstar Games released a new launch trailer for Grand Theft Auto VI.

sources.quote: which just put out a brief "launch" trailer for the game
A new launch trailer for Grand Theft Auto VI reveals more details about what's set to be the biggest game of the year.

claims.statement: Grand Theft Auto VI is about a month away from release.

sources.quote: The day is almost here, as Grand Theft Auto VI is just about a month away from finally coming out

discrepancies.explanation: One outlet says the new trailer doesn't reveal much new, while the other says it reveals more details about the game.

quotes.quote: The day is almost here, as Grand Theft Auto VI is just about a month away from finally coming out. But before that there's still one more look from Rockstar Games, which just put out a brief "launch" trailer for the game. It doesn't reveal much new
